scientific_integrity: The capacity, count and orbit decomposition are established by exhaustive exact integer determinant enumeration over the complete sixteen-line domain. The weak-phase-retrieval consequence separately invokes the published minimal-cardinality full-spark theorem; finite computation is not used as evidence for an infinite-domain statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to real flat vectors in the standard coordinates of dimension five. It does not decide whether arbitrary non-flat eight-vector weak-phase-retrieval frames exist in dimension five. The orbit classification is under signed coordinate permutations modulo global sign.
title: Full-spark capacity of five-dimensional flat sign lines
